body:
Euphoric Mescaline Trip--My Best Trip
I cut off a piece of about 10 inches of bridge.  The cactus is almost dead.  It is dehydrated and is thin, a top cutting of a 4ft bridge.  So I despined it, and travel out out a backroad that head out to the mountains.
The piece of cactus was ugly looking, and there was no white core inside.  there was just green
meat inside.  I just bit off pieces and started to chew.  I chew the 10 inchs in 45 minutes, and eat about 2 inches I had cut before.
I had a some root beer, and a few beers.  I took 150mg of Wellbutrin, SR, AND I usually take 300mg.  I dose it for depression.
About 45 minutes later I started feeling very good.  I thought it was just the Wellbutrin released dopamine, and It was not mescaline.  By one hour I stopped and puked.  I look at the sky was thinking that sky was really nice.  It was bright blue, and the scattered clouds were pink.
I was getting very euphoric, and was thinking about this girl at a coffee shop.  In about 30 more minutes I stopped to take some pics.  I look down at the road, and all the rocks were blue.  The mescaline was coming on really strong, and I was getting a bit anxious.  The trees were very animated.  This was get very strange, yet I still had a very good euphoria. I started back to city, about 1130, and it was getting hard to drive.  I got to the store, and now I was tripping.  Was getting very euphoric and had strong sexual thoughts.  I headed inside, I saw the girl, I call her magic girl.
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
I looked at her and she was glowing.  She was all green, blue, and aqua colored, and some purple.  Everything was shimmering and shiny, and things move around, like everything was animated and moving.  I had strong tracers.  I tried to talk but I couldn't talk.
So when to the bar, sat down, and had a coke and talked two girls I knew.  I had this same tripping effects coming and going, in waves.  This lasted about 4 hours, and I left and got a little food.
By 430 the trip was about over, a total of 8 hours of tripping that was quite strong.  Besides that, It came on fast.
This trip was total love. I thought it was a really good trip, and planning another in the same area.
I still have an afterglow today.  The only hangover was I was tired the next day.
